text:
alex: Heads up — found a mismatch between the KMS runbook and the audit fieldwork schedule. We have an attestation window next Tue but staging smoke is set to Thu. Need owners to confirm.
maria: Ack, thanks. Which attestation window time? timezone?
alex: 2024-06-18 14:00 UTC (from the auditor calendar). From the compliance doc: attestation slots say 06/20.
ben: Oof. Looks like calendar vs runbook drift. I own the staging smoke. I can move to Tue AM. Any blockers?
jordana: We need the HSM team to confirm key rotation won't run during smoke. @samir can you confirm?
samir: I can pause rotation for that slot. Quick Q: do we need to snapshot auditlogs before smoke? If yes, who runs it?
maria: Yes — auditor explicitly wants a pre-snapshot. @ben can you trigger a log-backup job to s3-prod-audit 1 hour prior?
ben: Yeah I can. Will run backup script: ```./scripts/audit-backup.sh --dest s3://prod-audit/attest/1718700000``` and ping when done.
alex: Also noticed evidence IDs in the runbook point to the old keystore path. Migration to /var/keystore-v2 wasn't reflected. Is that doc drift?
jordana: That's me — I updated infra but forgot to propagate to the compliance doc. Will update by EOD.
samir: For HSM attestation we need the HSM serial number on the evidence. The new HSM has a different SN pattern. Ben, does the backup include hardware metadata?
ben: It does if you pass --include-meta. I'll include that flag.
maria: Good. Can we get an explicit owner list for the whole slot? Suggest: staging smoke owner=ben, HSM config=samir, evidence doc update=jordana, compliance liaison=maria, oncall=alex.
alex: Sounds good. @deploy-bot any automated conflicts? (we sometimes have calendar automation)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Detected calendar overlap: attestation 2024-06-18 14:00 UTC conflicts with daily deployment window 14:00-15:00 UTC. Recommend moving attestation to 16:00 UTC or patching deploy window.
jordana: We should avoid moving deploys; auditors prefer earlier. Samir can we shift rotation earlier/later?
samir: I'll shift rotation task from 14:00 to 15:30 for that day. Should be fine.
ben: Backup scheduled for 13:00 UTC, will include --include-meta, will post S3 path once uploaded.
maria: Thanks. Can each owner add the checklist item to the compliance ticket #SEC-482 with ETA? I'm adding the checklist summary now.
alex: I'll be on standby during the slot. If anyone hits blocker ping #oncall.
ben: Upload done: s3://prod-audit/attest/2024-06-18-13-51.tar.gz
jordana: Doc updated: https://internal.docs/redwood/compliance/kms-attestation (changed keystore paths + evidence IDs). Please review.
samir: HSM rotation rescheduled to 15:30 UTC, confirmed with ops.
maria: Closing loop — I've added owners to SEC-482 and set milestone to 2024-06-18. Thanks all :tada:
alex: Great. Small follow-up: let's add a parity check script to validate runbook vs calendar automatically. Ben/Jordana interested?
ben: Yep, happy to prototype.
jordana: +1, will pair after this sprint.
